title: WORK-LAB V2 three-project ownership boundary (control plane vs knowledge vs design)
precedenceNote: User's 2026-09-22 convergence instruction is the top directive; this file is the machine-readable expression of it. It never overrides WORK-LAB-AUTHORITY.md or the project authority index — it records the boundary split they authorize.

projects.WORK-LAB: Control plane: who / when / with what permission / through what software / how to execute / how to verify / how to recover. Cross-project, cross-software, cross-runtime execution + governance.
projects.ArcheAxis-Knowledge-OS: Knowledge: long-term memory, learning, distillation, knowledge truth, classification, promotion, storage, recall.
projects.DESIGN-LAB: Design domain: design agents, design software execution, design assets, generation strategy, quality system, Adobe domain logic.

keepInWorklab: M1 prompt mutation, M2 skill mutation, M3 workflow mutation, M4 tool/runtime mutation, M5 governance mutation
boundary_splits.semantics: WORK-LAB Evolution = workflow/runtime/config/skill improvement governance; ArcheAxis Evolution = knowledge/memory/learning evolution
boundary_splits.seam: services/evolution boundary marker + mutation_policy governance scope assertion

boundary_splits.action: root-level 90-archive/ is a second history system -> converge to docs/history (single history retrieval anchor)

boundary_splits.worklabManages: Open Design client: rules, skills, plugins, capability discovery, workflow policy, adapter, software state (MANAGE, apply_supported=false)
